questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I haven't seen him for years,' she said.
options: She said that she hadn't seen him for years.
She said that she didn't see him for years.
She said that she hasn't seen him for years.
She said that she hasn't seen him for years.
questions.answer: She said that she hadn't seen him for years.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice? 
A. The letter was written by me.
B. The letter was writing by me.
C. The letter is written by me.
D. The letter is writing by me.
options: A. The letter was written by me.
B. The letter was writing by me.
C. The letter is written by me.
D. The letter is writing by me.
questions.answer: A. The letter was written by me.

Which sentence uses the correct phrasal verb meaning 'to give up'? 
A. She dropped the idea completely.
B. She gave up the idea completely.
C. She threw away the idea completely.
D. She discarded the idea completely.
options: A. She dropped the idea completely.
B. She gave up the idea completely.
C. She threw away the idea completely.
D. She discarded the idea completely.
questions.answer: B. She gave up the idea completely.
